newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Omnitel says GSM clients total 1.25 mln.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Omnitel says GSM clients total 1.25 mln.

text.p: Italy's second GSM mobile phone service operator Omnitel, which is controlled by an Olivetti -led consortium, said on Tuesday it had 1.254 million customers at the end of the first half of 1997, up 400 percent on the same period in 1996.
Omnitel said in a statement the increase was in part due to subscriptions to its rechargeable phone card service, which now totalled 30 percent of all subscriptions.
Omnitel director general Vittorio Colao said: "Today we have nearly 40 percent of the new GSM market."
Information and technology group Olivetti controls 35.5 percent of the Omnitel consortium.
